home.title: EMS Alliance (EMSA) | Hands-on training for a safer campus
home.description: EMS Alliance (EMSA) is a registered student organization at Miami University that teaches free CPR, First Aid, and Stop the Bleed classes and distributes naloxone. Any Miami student can join: no requirements, no dues.

what-we-do.title: What We Do | EMS Alliance (EMSA)
what-we-do.description: EMSA's programs: free AHA BLS and Heartsaver CPR/First Aid classes, Stop the Bleed training, Project DAWN naloxone distribution, fraternity-house harm reduction, K–6 Outreach, and an AHA Heart Club.

join.title: Join EMSA | EMS Alliance (EMSA)
join.description: Join EMS Alliance: open to any Miami student, no requirements, no dues, about 1 hour a week. Hands-on emergency skills, AHA instruction, and volunteer and outreach experience.

cpr-classes.title: CPR Classes | EMS Alliance (EMSA)
cpr-classes.description: Free AHA BLS and Heartsaver CPR/First Aid classes and Stop the Bleed training on campus, usually on Sundays. Register for a class or request one for your group.

naloxone.title: Naloxone & Harm Reduction | EMS Alliance (EMSA)
naloxone.description: Free naloxone (Narcan) through Ohio's Project DAWN program, fentanyl test strips, and harm reduction supplies from EMSA. No name required to request.

emergency.title: In an Emergency: Call 911 | EMS Alliance (EMSA)
emergency.description: In an emergency, call 911. EMS Alliance does not respond to emergencies. What to tell the dispatcher, hands-only CPR, AED basics, and what to do for a suspected opioid overdose.

events.title: Events | EMS Alliance (EMSA)
events.description: EMSA's calendar: free CPR classes, general body meetings, the Narcan distribution night, and K–6 Outreach events.

about.title: About | EMS Alliance (EMSA)
about.description: EMS Alliance was founded in fall 2024 at Miami University. Leadership, AHA-certified instructors, affiliations, recognition as Miami University's 2024–25 New Student Organization of the Year, and impact so far.

faq.title: FAQ | EMS Alliance (EMSA)
faq.description: Answers for prospective members, class participants, and partners: who can join, time commitment, free AHA classes and eCards, affiliations, and why EMSA does not respond to emergencies.

contact.title: Contact | EMS Alliance (EMSA)
contact.description: Contact EMS Alliance: email, social media, the club GroupMe, and EMSA's Miami Central page. In an emergency, call 911.

privacy.title: Privacy | EMS Alliance (EMSA)
privacy.description: What EMS Alliance collects on its website forms, why, who can see it, and how long it's kept. No cookies, no trackers, and no name on naloxone requests.
